mentions.name: smalldocs
mentions.description: An open-source, free-to-use artifact layer for coding agents with a simply styled but functionally deep output format. It combines charts, diagrams, and spreadsheets into a single artifact suitable for creating and optionally sharing agent-generated analysis. Includes a local library for Markdown files plus a paid cloud library, both with tagging and rich search/filtering, turning artifacts into easily revisitable checkpoints in work.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building https://smalldocs.org, it’s a simply styled, but functionally deep, artifact layer for agents. It’s open source and free to use.
mentions.author: FailMore
